title: Plasma-assisted modification of micronutrient-embedded PVA/PVP blend films for sustained nutrient delivery in agricultural applications
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00462D, Paper
Open Access

Nandhu Varshini Gnanasekar, Shanmugavelayutham Gurusamy
Plasma treatment effectively modified polymer surfaces through crosslinking, facilitating controlled nutrient release. Plasma-treated polymeric systems provide an advanced platform for controlled micronutrient delivery in agricultural applications.
